manifest.name: file-input
manifest.title: FileInput
manifest.description: A file picker on a native <input type="file"> (Base UI's Input), as one line like an Input or as a dashed dropzone, with a Clear button and accept filtering of dropped files.
manifest.usage: Use FileInput to pick local files the app reads in the browser or sends with the form: a CA certificate, a key, SQL scripts to import. Put it in a Field with a FieldLabel; set accept (".pem,.crt", "image/*") and multiple as on the native input. Read the files from onFilesChange ([] when cleared); with TanStack Form, keep File[] in the field and call field.handleChange from onFilesChange. The dropzone variant also takes dropped files (filtered by accept) and suits imports; the field variant suits settings forms. Nothing is uploaded by the component; it has no network code.

props.name: onFilesChange
props.description: Called with the chosen or dropped files; [] when cleared.

props.name: accept
props.description: Allowed extensions and MIME types, as on the native input; also filters dropped files.

props.name: variant
props.description: One line like an Input, or a dashed area that takes dropped files.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the field variant from size.control.*, which follows data-density.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown while no file is chosen.

props.name: dropLabel
props.description: The dropzone's instruction, before the chip.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name; a Field's name wins.

props.name: required
props.description: A file must be chosen before the form submits.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the picker and hides Clear.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the frame, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The frame; data-slot="file-input", data-variant, data-size, data-dragging. Clicking it opens the picker.

slots.name: input
slots.description: The native <input type="file">, visually hidden but focusable; data-slot="file-input-input".

slots.name: names
slots.description: The chosen files' names (or emptyLabel), aria-hidden; data-slot="file-input-names".

slots.name: clear
slots.description: The Clear button, hidden while no file is chosen.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over the Clear button: color.interactive.hover and color.fg.default.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus on the input: a ring of ring.width in color.ring around the frame.

states.name: dragging
states.description: A file is dragged over the dropzone: accent border and color.accent.subtle-bg.

states.name: empty
states.description: No file chosen: emptyLabel in color.fg.subtle.

states.name: invalid
states.description: In an invalid Field (or with aria-invalid): the frame's border is color.status.danger.border.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Ignores interaction; the frame dims to opacity.disabled.

accessibility: The control is a native <input type="file">, visually hidden but focusable: Tab reaches it, Space or Enter opens the system picker, and screen readers announce its label and the chosen file.
The chip and the file names repeat what the input announces, so they are aria-hidden; the FieldLabel names the input and clicking it opens the picker.
Dropping files is a pointer shortcut only; the same files can always be chosen with the keyboard. Announce what was added in a role="status" element.
The Clear button is named "Clear file" and returns focus to the input.
Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring around the frame (3:1 on every surface).
